name: Longju
summary:
Longju is a nostalgic, Far Eastern fantasy MMORPG that blends the classic charm of legendary browser games with modern, accessible Idle mechanics. Designed for players who love deep character progression but have limited time, the game automates routine tasks while keeping strategic decisions, trading, and community elements in the player's hands.

Players can choose from distinct character classes, explore diverse and dangerous lands, defeat powerful bosses, and collect rare, upgradable gear that dynamically changes their avatar's appearance. Longju features a fully player-driven economy with an active Auction House, as well as a robust Guild system where alliances fight for server dominance, expand shared strongholds, and participate in strategic group battles. The game will be entirely Free-To-Play and accessible across multiple platforms, including mobile devices and PC web browsers.
